entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Minor Basilica of the Immaculate Conception is a Colombian Catholic basilica located in Jardín, Antioquia, within the Roman Catholic Diocese of Jericó. It is a Neo-Gothic temple that lacks a rib vault and occupies an area of 1.680 m2, built entirely from hand carved stone quarried in the foothills of the town.
